info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Andesite Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of detailed entries for the Andesite notebook catalog. Users can submit comprehensive information about notebook specifications and features, enabling easier access and organization of product data. Typically utilized by product managers and catalog administrators, this API streamlines the process of updating the inventory with new or modified items. Integrating this API allows for efficient management and enhancement of the overall product catalog.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for an Andesite notebook. It enables the submission of essential notebook attributes and settings, facilitating the creation of tailored notebook experiences.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit detailed information about the Andesite notebook. The data sent in this request should conform to the specified JSON schema, which includes all necessary attributes for processing the notebook details.

200.description: Request completed successfully and data returned.

CreateCatalogAndesiteNotebookDetailReque.title: Andesite Notebook Details Request

andesite_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier for the Andesite Notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the Andesite Notebook.

quantity.description: The quantity of Andesite Notebooks requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Andesite Notebook.

CreateCatalogAndesiteNotebookDetailReque.description: Schema representing the request body for creating or updating Andesite Notebook details.
